The goal of the partnership is to use PrGIS more in clinical trials, as well as boost access to precision oncology treatments via potential companion diagnostics.
PrGIS is a "biomarker signature designed to assess chromosomal instability associated with homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) in prostate cancer patients," according to a

Myriad created PrGIS to support HRD as a biomarker in prostate cancer. The company's MyChoice CDx test, used as a companion diagnostic for ovarian cancer, will determine the PrGIS score and is being developed for a prostate cancer indication.

title: Myriad, SOPHiA partner with AstraZeneca to use prostate cancer technology
